rules.title: How it works
rules.betTypesDesc: For each match you predict the outcome by choosing one of 6 options:
rules.scoringDesc: When your prediction is correct, you earn points equal to the odds set for that bet. The less likely the outcome, the higher the odds, and the more points you earn.
rules.lockDesc: You can place or change your bet any time before kickoff. Once the match starts, your bet is locked and everyone's predictions become visible.
rules.compoundDesc: A compound bet covers two outcomes. For example, 1X wins if the home team wins OR the match ends in a draw. Compound bets have lower odds since they're more likely to hit.
rules.missedDesc: If you don't place a bet before kickoff, you score 0 points for that match. Make sure to submit your predictions on time!
